evidence.title: Memory module documentation
evidence.content: The default uniform decay rate is 10 percent per month. This is the value the runtime applies to every memory unless a per-mode override is declared.

evidence.title: Tuning revision note
evidence.content: Decision: the default confidence decay rate should be 5 percent per month, half of the previously-shipped 10 percent. Rationale: long-lived research conversations were losing relevant context too quickly.
